## Activity

East City Eye Clinic recorded 118 captures during March 2021. This activity represents the imaging completed at the site during the reporting month. The available activity figure is reported as captures, providing the basis for the subsequent image-quality and grading measures.

## Image quality

Of the images captured, 2 were assessed as ungradable. The ungradable rate was 1.7. These images could not be used for grading and are reported separately from images that proceeded to assessment. The result provides an indication of the proportion of the month’s imaging that did not produce a gradable image.

## Grading

Grading identified 25 referable results from the activity completed at East City Eye Clinic in March 2021. The median lag between capture and grading was 1 day. This measure summarises the central turnaround time for the grading process during the month. Together, the activity, image-quality and grading results provide a concise view of service performance at the site for the reporting period.
